segments.en: 07 · The premise
segments.tr: 07 · 前提

segments.en: Can an AI reliably write a language it's barely seen?
segments.tr: AI 能可靠地写一门它几乎没见过的语言吗？

segments.en: Mostly. Glyph reads like TypeScript: the same primitive and generic types (string, number, Array<T>), most of the same expressions, and npm packages imported by name. It is not a subset of TypeScript: match, Result and fn name(x: T) -> R are syntax TypeScript does not have, and if, the ternary and casts are not Glyph. Most of what a model already knows carries over, and the compiler names the places it doesn't.
segments.tr: 大体上可以。Glyph 读起来像 TypeScript：同样的基本类型和泛型类型（string、number、Array<T>），大部分相同的表达式，npm 包也按名字导入。它不是 TypeScript 的子集：match、Result 和 fn name(x: T) -> R 是 TypeScript 没有的语法，而 if、三元表达式和类型断言不属于 Glyph。模型已有的知识大多能直接沿用，编译器会指出那些不能沿用的地方。

segments.en: Why it matters
segments.tr: 为什么重要

segments.en: It's the fair skeptic's question: an LLM predicts the next token from the huge body of existing-language code, so a language with almost no training data should be hard to write. The answer is structural: Glyph isn't alien. It looks like TypeScript, so the model already knows most of it; the differences are few, enumerable, and each one fails fast at compile time rather than passing silently.
segments.tr: 这是一个合理的质疑：LLM 根据大量现有语言的代码预测下一个 token，所以一门几乎没有训练数据的语言应该很难写。答案在于结构：Glyph 并不陌生。它看起来像 TypeScript，所以模型已经懂得其中大部分；差异很少，可以逐一列出，而且每一处都会在编译时立即失败，而不是悄悄通过。

segments.en: See it
segments.tr: 看看实际效果

segments.en: An agent that guesses wrong doesn't ship the guess. It gets a precise, fixable error and corrects in the same loop:
segments.tr: 猜错的智能体不会把猜测发布出去。它会得到一个精确、可修复的错误，并在同一轮循环中改正：

segments.en: the correction loop, in one step
segments.tr: 一步完成的修正循环

segments.en: The error names the Glyph construct and shows the shape, so the fix is one edit away: no source-diving, no guessing. That tight loop is what compensates for the missing training data. One document, llms.txt, gives an agent the program shape, the standard library and every diagnostic with its fix, and glyph llms prints the same reference offline.
segments.tr: 错误信息指出对应的 Glyph 结构并给出写法，所以修复只差一次编辑：不用翻源码，也不用猜。正是这个紧凑的循环弥补了训练数据的不足。一份文档 llms.txt 就能给智能体提供程序结构、标准库，以及每条诊断及其修复方法，glyph llms 也能离线打印同样的参考内容。

segments.tr: 现已提供

segments.tr: TypeScript 风格的语法，带稳定错误码并指出修复方法的报错，以及作为任何智能体统一参考文档的 llms.txt / glyph llms。

segments.en: Being proven
segments.tr: 正在验证

segments.en: A success-rate benchmark (tries-to-correct against TypeScript on the same task) to turn “it held up” into a measured number.
segments.tr: 一个成功率基准测试（在同一任务上与 TypeScript 比较改正所需的尝试次数），把“它经受住了考验”变成一个测得的数字。
